title: Golden Whip Stream - the most scenic trail
text: A 7.5 km trail along a mountain stream through a canyon of quartzite pillars. This is a must-do route, taking 2.5-3 hours one-way. Flat path with minimal elevation, clear stream, wooden bridges and curious wild macaques along the way.

title: 99 Bends to Tianmen Heaven's Gate
text: The Tongtian Avenue is an 11 km mountain road with 99 hairpin turns, leading up to Tianmen's Heaven's Gate - a natural rock arch 131 m high. Riding the special park buses along this legendary serpentine is an unforgettable 25-30 minute experience.

title: Tianmen Cable Car - 7,455 meters long
text: The longest passenger cable car in the world, rising 1,279 m from the city center straight to the summit of Tianmen Mountain. The 28-minute ride carries you over the city, through forests and past sheer cliffs at a final angle of 37 degrees.

title: Zhangjiajie Glass Bridge - 430 meters above the abyss
text: The Glass Bridge in the Zhangjiajie Grand Canyon was the longest and highest glass bridge in the world when it opened. Length 430 m, height 300 m above the canyon, width 6 m, three-layer glass 4 cm thick. Ticket 138 yuan.

title: Bailong Elevator - 326 meters straight up
text: Bailong is the tallest outdoor elevator in the world, a Guinness record holder. It carries visitors to the top of the Avatar Mountains plateau in just 92 seconds. Height 326 m, speed 3 m/s, capacity 50 people, ticket 65 yuan one-way.
